# Expert Reviewer Database — Sesame Street & Muppet Edition

A comprehensive pool of expert reviewers for AI-simulated paper reviews across all research modules.

**Scope**: Global — shared across all modules in this mock monorepo.
**Per-module subsets**: See `{module}/REVIEWERS.md` for module-specific selections.

---
